title: This Open-Source Repo Uses Claude Code to Automate Your Entire Job Search at Scale
description: This Open-Source Repo Uses Claude Code to Automate Your Entire Job Search at Scale
transcript: If you're using Claude code in job hunting, this repo is worth checking out. It's called Career Ops. It combines Claude code, Playwright, and a full set of skills to automate your job search. But, it's not just blasting out applications. It actually filters roles, tailors your approach, and generates ATS-friendly resumes for each listing. So, instead of generic submissions, you're sending targeted applications at scale. And the whole thing is open source. Just search Career Ops on GitHub, and you'll find it.
